messages:
sam: Heads up — PR #8342 is a small cherry-pick for the kv-cache race we saw in prod. We need 2x LGTM before tonight's cutover (cutoff 18:00 UTC). Smoke canary is flaky; CI passed but saw one intermittent timeout. Can people please give quick eyes? If anything blocks we'll rollback the cherry-pick.
anya: Can you paste the failing smoke log or a short repro? I can try to reproduce locally.
sam: repro steps in the PR description. quick paste: `timeout in kv_warmup.go: AcquireLock timeout after 2s on node 3` — looks like backoff timing under load. CI run: https://ci.example.com/builds/8342 (green except one flake)
taylor: I can take a look, but will need one small change: add short note about the env var fix in RELEASE_NOTES.md so support isn't surprised. Otherwise +1 on the change itself.
sam: will add the RELEASE_NOTES entry now and push an amended commit.
release-bot: Reminder: release window opens 18:15 UTC, merge freeze at 18:00 UTC. Any merges after cutoff will be held for next window. (scheduled by @release-engineering)
maria: skimming the patch — looks safe and scoped. LGTM. I can be on merge duty at cutoff and watch canary.
sam: thanks @maria, really appreciate it. @taylor any chance you can give final LGTM after the notes update? We need one more before 18:00.
taylor: saw the notes update, taking a quick look now... LGTM.
sam: Awesome — got both LGTM. I'll coordinate the merge at 18:01 and monitor canary. If smoke flips, rollback sequence is `git revert <cherry-pick-commit>` then `./scripts/rollback.sh`. Thanks everyone :tada:
anya: Thanks — ping me if it behaves oddly and I'll help investigate.
maria: :thumbsup: good job team.
